mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, p.identifier, p.parent_project_id, p.project_name, p.description, p.start_date, p.end_date, c1.code_name AS status, c2.code_name AS is_public, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.created_by, u1.user_name AS pm_user_id, u2.user_name AS pl_user_id, p.editor_user_id, c3.code_name AS use_milestone FROM projects p JOIN common_code c1 ON p.status = c1.code_value JOIN common_code c2 ON p.is_public = c2.code_value JOIN common_code c3 ON p.use_milestone = c3.code_value JOIN users u1 ON p.pm_user_id = u1.user_id JOIN users u2 ON p.pl_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: UPDATE projects SET project_name = #{projectName}, identifier = #{identifier}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = SYSDATE, pl_user_id = #{plUserId}, use_milestone = #{useMilestone} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
